You open your eyes. And three strangers are staring at you.
No ceiling. No signal. Nobody speaks your language.
You've woken up fifty thousand years ago.
At least four kinds of humans walk the Earth. And you're the only one who can't make fire.
Forty minutes later, you have a blister. And a slightly warm stick.
The kid next to you does it in ten seconds.
Then the tribe wants to know what you're actually good for.
Then you meet a Neanderthal. And he's better than you at everything.
If your family comes from outside Africa, around two percent of your DNA may come from people like him.
So he might be your great, great, great, very great grandpa. You decide not to tell him.
But the real problem? The sun is going down. And the dark isn't empty.
Would you survive the first night? Tell me in the comments.
